# quilt-egg (Rust port)

> **The smallest Quilt substrate that can BE — Rust edition.**

DNA-first alignment. Cellular relationships as first-class objects.
Immutable physics constants. Polyformalism canary verified.

## Quick start

```bash
cargo build --release
cargo test --release
```

## Polyformalism

Same canon, same byte-exact canary:

```
fnv1a-64("café Δ 日本語") = 0x024a555471370b18d
```

Verified on all 7+ ports of the Quilt polyformalism fleet:
Python, TypeScript, **Rust** (this port), Bash, JS ESM, C#/.NET 9, SQL/SQLite.

## What's in this port

- `default_dna()` — 5 bedrock doctrines + 7 action axioms
- `EggCell::new(rank, dna, parent)` — hatch a cell
- `cell.relate_to(other_rank, weight)` — form a cellular relationship
- `cell.tick()` — walk one step
- `cell.cut_cord()` — sever the umbilical
- `fnv1a_64(s)` — verify the canary

## Origin

This is the Rust port of [SuperInstance/quilt-egg](https://github.com/SuperInstance/quilt-egg)
(Python reference). The polyformalism doctrine says: same canon, many
languages, byte-exact.
